row: At our Hälsa Clinics, we specialise in providing first class care for those with aches, pains and mobility issues. Whether you are suffering from back pain, neck pain, headaches and stress or recovering from injury etc., we can help get you back to health again through a natural and drug free approach to healing. We have centres across Berkshire, Buckinghamshire and Surrey.
